seoTitle: Email Send Time Zone Planner: Local Arrival Times
metaDescription: See the local arrival time of a scheduled email in each subscriber time zone, with overnight arrivals flagged. DST is applied for the date.
intro: Enter a send date and time in your zone and a list of subscriber zones to see when it lands for each.
why:
A 9:00 send in Brussels arrives at 4:00 in New York. For international lists, a quick table of local times shows which regions get the email overnight and which in working hours.

Daylight saving is applied using the date you choose, through the browser's built-in time zone data. Zones need IANA names such as Europe/Paris. Arrival is not opening: people read when they want to.
howTo: Enter your time zone, send date and time.
List subscriber time zones, one per line.
Read the local times and flags.

faq.q: How do I find zone names?
faq.a: Use IANA names like America/Chicago. Optional labels go before a pipe.
Yes, for the date you give.

faq.q: What if the time does not exist on DST day?
faq.a: The result shifts by the offset change.
